latin: Quamuis dicat Abucaten quod esse, quod est primum creatum, est super intelligentiam, non credas tamen illud secundum hypostasim esse distinctum ab intelligentia.
translation: Granted that Abucaten calls existence—the first created thing—superior to intelligence, do not conclude from this that it is a distinct hypostasis set apart from intelligence.
